E5lebaDUd25Vm3VP-UgnFQ.zh: WHO報告指出,非洲流腦帶(African Meningitis Belt),從塞內加爾延伸至衣索比亞等26國,去年計有24國累計報告21,526例疑病例、971例死亡(致死率:4.5%),病例較前年下降5.9%。目前正推動5價疫苗(Men5CV/MMCV),其中日(Niger)已於去年展開全國性疫苗接種活動。
E5lebaDUd25Vm3VP-UgnFQ.en: WHO reports that the African Meningitis Belt, which extends from Senegal to Ethiopia across 26 countries, recorded 21,526 suspected cases and 971 deaths (case fatality rate 4.5%) in 24 countries last year, with cases down 5.9% from the previous year. The pentavalent meningococcal vaccine (Men5CV/MMCV) is being promoted, and Niger launched a nationwide vaccination campaign last year.

y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/9-15期間,WPV1新增阿富汗4例;cVDPV1新增2國共3例,分別為衣索比亞2例、南蘇丹1例;cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國2例、查德1例;cVDPV3新增奈及利亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共13件,分別為阿富汗12件、巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1新增馬達加斯加2件。
y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 9–15 July: WPV1 cases increased by 4 in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Ethiopia and 1 in South Sudan; cVDPV2 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and cVDPV3 cases increased by 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 13 across 2 countries, with 12 in Afghanistan and 1 in Pakistan, and cVDPV1 increased by 2 in Madagascar.

44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.zh: 小兒麻痺症全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/18-24期間,cVDPV1 新增2國共3例,分別為寮國2例(前已掌握)、衣索比亞1例;cVDPV2新增中非共和國/馬利各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增奈及利亞1件。
44VM-a8M61mNqd6ddNEdjA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 18–24 June: cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Laos (previously identified) and 1 in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 each in the Central African Republic and Mali; and for environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by 1 in Nigeria.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/7-13期間,cVDPV1新增衣索比亞4例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞6例、剛果民主共和國3例及蘇丹1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件。
jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 May, cVDPV1 added four cases in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: six in Nigeria, three in the DRC and one in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added nine specimens in Pakistan.

CiPeDFhaN5KIgr3hNxqoYA.zh: 衣索比亞於1/26宣布首次疫情結束,自去(2025)年12/14最後1例確診病例死亡以來,已連續2個潛伏期(共42天)未通報新增病例,且所有密切接觸者(857名)均已完成21天追蹤。該國疫情於去年11/14爆發後,截至疫情結束,南部地區共計4個縣報告19例,其中14例為確診(含9例死亡),5例為疑(均死亡)。全球於此案前已累計報告19起疫情,前起疫情為坦尚亞於去年1-3月報告,非洲區域其他曾通報疫情之國家包括安哥拉、剛果民主共和國、赤道幾內亞、迦納、幾內亞、肯亞、盧安達、南非及烏干達。
CiPeDFhaN5KIgr3hNxqoYA.en: Ethiopia declared the end of its first outbreak on 26 January. Since the last confirmed case died on 14 December 2025, two incubation periods (42 days in total) have passed without any new cases reported, and all 857 close contacts completed 21 days of follow-up. The outbreak began on 14 November 2025. By its end, 19 cases had been reported in four districts of the southern region: 14 confirmed (including 9 deaths) and 5 suspected (all died). Before this outbreak, 19 outbreaks had been reported globally. The previous outbreak was reported by Tanzania in January–March 2025. Other African countries that have reported outbreaks include Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Equatorial Guinea, Ghana, Guinea, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa and Uganda.

NEJnX6-LwZw2DcAX5LlP6w.zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,12/12新增通報1例確診病例,自11/12迄今累計報告14例確診,其中9例死亡(CFR:64.2%),5例已康復。
NEJnX6-LwZw2DcAX5LlP6w.en: Update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: one new confirmed case was reported on 12 December. Since 12 November, 14 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 9 died (CFR: 64.2%) and 5 have recovered.

QoFSuDxqKVSIUeW5Sjqlgw.zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,12/3新增通報1例,自11/12迄今累計報告13例確診病例,其中8例死亡(CFR:61.5%),4例已康復,1例仍治療中。此為全球第19起疫情,前次為坦尚亞於今年1-3月發生之疫情。
QoFSuDxqKVSIUeW5Sjqlgw.en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: one new case was reported on 3 December. Since 12 November, a cumulative 13 confirmed cases have been reported, of which 8 died (CFR 61.5%), 4 have recovered and 1 is still under treatment. This is the 19th outbreak recorded worldwide; the previous one occurred in Tanzania from January to March this year.

XwK-EZnAYNBk-iXnvlIAZg.zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡地區疫情更新,自11/12-25累計報告10例確診病例,其中5例死亡,另3例疑死亡。此為該國首次通報疫情,該病目前尚無藥物或疫苗,僅能支持性治療,目前疫情來源及流行病學特徵仍待釐清調查,另迄今之死亡病例均逕行下葬,又該區鄰近肯亞及南蘇丹,評估國內傳播風險為高,區域為中,全球則為低。
XwK-EZnAYNBk-iXnvlIAZg.en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: from 12 to 25 November, a cumulative 10 confirmed cases were reported, of which 5 died, and 3 further deaths are suspected. This is the country's first reported outbreak. The disease currently has no drug or vaccine, and only supportive treatment is available. The source of the outbreak and its epidemiological characteristics are still under investigation. All deaths to date have been buried directly. The area borders Kenya and South Sudan. The assessed risk of spread within the country is high, the regional risk is medium, and the global risk is low.

BSyUXzCEYL15-fMk6jpsCQ.zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡(Jinka)地區疫情更新,截至11/18累積報告26例疑病例,其中4例確診病例,3例確診死亡,當局已匡列129名接觸者,並進行隔離治療及社區篩檢等措施。
BSyUXzCEYL15-fMk6jpsCQ.en: An update on the outbreak in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia: as of 18 November, 26 suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, including 4 confirmed cases and 3 confirmed deaths. Authorities have identified 129 contacts and implemented isolation treatment, community screening and other measures.

j1to4NTMtPbXTmP2-dE0YQ.zh: 衣索比亞南部金卡(Jinka)地區爆發疫情,截至11/14累積報告9例病例,其中6例死亡,包含2名醫護人員,患者出現高燒、頭痛、腹瀉及出血等症狀,部分患者入院後24小時內死亡;當局檢測其病毒型別與先前在東非流行的病毒株相同,已展開隔離治療、接觸者追蹤、及社區篩檢等措施;另今年1-3月在坦尚亞亦發生疫情,造成10例死亡。
j1to4NTMtPbXTmP2-dE0YQ.en: An outbreak has occurred in the Jinka area of southern Ethiopia. As of 14 November, 9 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 6 died, including 2 health workers. Patients presented with high fever, headache, diarrhoea and bleeding, and some died within 24 hours of admission. Authorities tested the virus and found it to be the same type as strains previously circulating in East Africa. Isolation treatment, contact tracing and community screening have been launched. Separately, an outbreak occurred in Tanzania from January to March this year, causing 10 deaths.

For environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by seven samples in two countries: Papua New Guinea (6) and Côte d'Ivoire (1).

V0Xnz_zVSCXaw3CaW6hFyw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/19-25期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例,cVDPV2新增3國共3例,分別為貝南/衣索比亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦1件,cVDPV1型陽性樣本新增吉布地1件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增3國共4例,分別為吉布地2件、坦尚亞/查德各1件。
V0Xnz_zVSCXaw3CaW6hFyw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 19 and 25 June, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 3 cases in 3 countries, one each in Benin, Ethiopia and Yemen. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by one in Pakistan, cVDPV1-positive samples increased by one in Djibouti, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 4 in 3 countries: 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Tanzania and Chad.

EqM8vJfoStwsWiudQPezhQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/12-18期間,cVDPV2新增2國共5例,分別為衣索比亞4例、貝南1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦47件,cVDPV1型陽性樣本新增吉布地8件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增巴布亞紐幾內亞2件。

For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 47 in Pakistan, cVDPV1-positive samples increased by 8 in Djibouti, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 2 in Papua New Guinea.

z6xhILcTyF1Yo0AEKZsA9w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/29-6/4期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例,cVDPV2新增5國共15例,分別為衣索比亞8例、葉門3例、查德2例、安哥拉/日各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加2國共4件,分別為吉布地3件、索馬利亞1件。
z6xhILcTyF1Yo0AEKZsA9w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 29 May and 4 June, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 15 cases in 5 countries: 8 in Ethiopia, 3 in Yemen, 2 in Chad, and 1 each in Angola and Niger. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 2 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Djibouti and 1 in Somalia.

CJzXSa5hFu9g8jF9HiROBg.zh: 西班牙報告1例境外移入病例,為44歲男性,於去(2024)年7月前往衣索比亞旅行期間腿部遭狗咬傷,僅進行傷口清洗,未進行狂犬病暴露後預防(PEP)治療,約10個月後出現發燒、情緒波動及恐水症等症狀住院治療,5/29確診後,注射免疫球蛋白,仍於6/6死亡。另患者妻子為唯一接觸者,已注射疫苗及免疫球蛋白,目前狀況良好。該國最近1例死亡病例為2019年自摩洛哥境外移入病例。
CJzXSa5hFu9g8jF9HiROBg.en: Spain reported one imported case, a 44-year-old man who was bitten on the leg by a dog during a trip to Ethiopia in July last year. He only had the wound cleaned and did not receive post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP). About 10 months later he developed fever, emotional changes and hydrophobia, and was hospitalized. He was confirmed on 29 May, received immunoglobulin, and died on 6 June. His wife, the only contact, has received vaccine and immunoglobulin and is doing well. Spain's most recent rabies death was an imported case from Morocco in 2019.

NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.zh: 亞洲:菲律賓南部民答那峨島疫情上升,5/22報告累計3省15例,其中南哥打巴托省10例、蘇丹庫達拉省3例、馬京達瑙省2例。另該島南部三寶顏錫布省報告該省首例,為3歲女童,於5/5就診採檢後確診,目前隔離治療,相關接觸者追蹤中。 非洲:  衣索比亞報告該國首起疫情,病患為該國南部邊境小鎮摩亞雷(Moyale) 1個月齡以下嬰兒及其母親,據調查,病患父親曾跨境前往鄰國,當局已隔離相關接觸者,並追蹤感染源,初步結果顯示為跨境傳播;當地為該國重要經貿及交通樞紐,與肯亞接壤,肯國近期有報告病例。 迦納今年截至5/21累計9例,病患分布於該國首都阿克拉及西部大區,該國於去(2024)年報告13例IIb型病例;多哥於5/16報告該國首例,截至5/22報告3例,皆分布於首都洛梅,病患隔離中,相關接觸者追蹤中。  歐洲:東南歐北馬其頓報告該國首起病例,2例確診病患皆已隔離接受治療,當局展開疫調中。
NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.en: Asia: the outbreak in the southern island of Mindanao in the Philippines is rising. As of 22 May, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively in 3 provinces: 10 in Lanao del Sur, 3 in Sultan Kudarat and 2 in Maguindanao. The island's southern province of Zamboanga Sibugay also reported its first case, a 3-year-old girl who was diagnosed after seeking care and sampling on 5 May. She is in isolation, and close contacts are being traced. Africa: Ethiopia reported its first outbreak in the country, involving an infant under one month old and the infant's mother, in Moyale, a small town on the southern border. According to investigation, the infant's father had travelled across the border to a neighbouring country. Close contacts have been isolated and the source of infection is being traced; preliminary results indicate cross-border transmission. The town is an important economic and transport hub on the border with Kenya, which has recently reported cases. Ghana reported 9 cases cumulatively this year as of 21 May, distributed in the capital Accra and the Western Region; Ghana reported 13 clade IIb cases in 2024. Togo reported its first case on 16 May; as of 22 May, 3 cases had been reported, all in the capital Lomé. Patients are in isolation and close contacts are being traced. Europe: North Macedonia reported its first case; the 2 confirmed patients are isolated and receiving treatment, and authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation.

2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/8-14期間,cVDPV2型新增4國共9例,分別為衣索比亞5例、蘇丹2例、布吉納法索/象牙海岸各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦11件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加3國共5件,分別為阿爾及利亞3件、查德/索馬利亞各1件。
2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 8 and 14 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 in 4 countries: 5 in Ethiopia, 2 in Sudan, and 1 each in Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 11 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 3 countries: 3 in Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Somalia.

xxkSS0JphoLy4e2m9TmnZQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/17-23期間,WPV1型新增阿富汗1例,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗1件。
xxkSS0JphoLy4e2m9TmnZQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 April, one new WPV1 case was reported in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, one new WPV1-positive sample was reported in Afghanistan.

d4taZDeL2z5QmKPkxLSP5w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/3-9期間,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、安哥拉1例。環境樣本部分,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增2國共2件,分別為以色列/象牙海岸各1件。
d4taZDeL2z5QmKPkxLSP5w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 April, cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 2 in 2 countries, 1 each in Israel and Côte d'Ivoire.

zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.zh: 非洲疫情持續且呈區域擴散趨勢,非洲區署公布第14週(3/31- 4/6)疫情,其中,安哥拉新增1,164例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:2%),疫情擴散至17個省份;衣索比亞疫情回升,新增322例病例,疫情主要於西北及西南部省分;迦納新增30例病例,較前週減少62%,集中於中部地區。WHO呼籲受影響國家強化飲水衛生、疫苗及治療等防疫措施。
zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.en: The outbreak in Africa continues and is spreading regionally. The WHO Regional Office for Africa published data for week 14 (31 March–6 April): in Angola, 1,164 new cases were reported, including 25 deaths (CFR 2%), and the outbreak has spread to 17 provinces. In Ethiopia the outbreak has resurged, with 322 new cases, mainly in the north-western and south-western provinces. Ghana reported 30 new cases, a 62% decrease from the previous week, concentrated in the central region. WHO calls on affected countries to strengthen preventive measures such as water and sanitation hygiene, vaccination and treatment.

k8-fef-AbHLd0NuazZqCfQ.zh: 衣索比亞疫情持續,於第6週報告13萬餘例病例及3例死亡,病例主要分布於該國中南部奧羅米亞州,今年截至2/8累計報告90萬餘例病例及34例死亡,另去年累計報告逾1千萬例病例。
k8-fef-AbHLd0NuazZqCfQ.en: Malaria in Ethiopia continues. In week 6, over 130,000 cases and 3 deaths were reported, mainly in the south-central Oromia Region. As of 8 February this year, over 900,000 cases and 34 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Over 10 million cases were reported cumulatively last year.

CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/13-19期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共6例病例,分別為索馬利亞4例、安哥拉/奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦12件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增7國共13件,分別為葉門5件、吉布地3件、安哥拉/查德/象牙海岸/衣索比亞/索馬利亞各1件。
CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

v780hgwLFQYBCmZCGQnWAQ.zh: 歐洲報告自今年迄2月底累計2國7例病例,分別為英國4例、德國3例,病患曾去衣索比亞或接觸衣國阿姆哈拉區之聖水,其中5例報告曾飲用來自疫區之瓶裝水,該瓶裝水亦檢測出病原,當局提醒旅客前往該國或接觸疫區之瓶裝水皆有感染風險。 安哥拉疫情持續升高,自1/7宣布爆發後,截至3月中旬已累計13省5,872例病例,其中937例確診、208例死亡,15歲以下兒童佔病例/死亡數之39%及35%。
v780hgwLFQYBCmZCGQnWAQ.en: Europe has reported 7 cholera cases in 2 countries from the start of this year to the end of February: 4 in the United Kingdom and 3 in Germany. The patients had travelled to Ethiopia or had consumed holy water from the Amhara Region of Ethiopia. Five cases reported drinking bottled water from an affected area, and the bottled water also tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities warn that travellers to Ethiopia, and bottled water from the affected areas, carry a risk of infection. Cholera in Angola continues to rise. Since the outbreak was declared on 7 January, 5,872 cases have been reported cumulatively from 13 provinces as of mid-March, including 937 confirmed cases and 208 deaths. Children under 15 account for 39% of cases and 35% of deaths.

P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/20-26期間,新增報告WPV1型巴基斯坦1例病例;cVDPV2型新增3國13例病例,分別為查德6例、衣索比亞5例、葉門2例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦13件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增6國10件,分別為德國4件、吉布地2件、查德/象牙海岸/波蘭/英國各1件。
P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 20 and 26 February, one new WPV1 case was reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 6 in Chad, 5 in Ethiopia and 2 in Yemen. For environmental samples, 13 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 10 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 6 countries: 4 in Germany, 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Poland and the United Kingdom.

Mt7xWnlnHg9eoh2x2A5kqw.zh: 衣索比亞疫情持續,今年迄今累計報告77萬餘例病例及31例死亡;2024年累計報告逾1千萬例病例。
Mt7xWnlnHg9eoh2x2A5kqw.en: Malaria in Ethiopia continues. So far this year, over 770,000 cases and 31 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Over 10 million cases were reported cumulatively in 2024.

s3Vl33nn5OuyKT-9sLK-pQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/23-29期間,巴基斯坦新增報告1例WPV1型;cVDPV2型新增報告2國11例病例,衣索比亞10例、日1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增3件WPV1型陽性樣本。 歐洲報告於去年9 -12月之常規廢水檢測中,在西班牙、英國、德國、波蘭、芬蘭皆檢測出cVDPV2型陽性樣本。
s3Vl33nn5OuyKT-9sLK-pQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported 11 new cVDPV2 cases, with 10 in Ethiopia and 1 in Niger. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported three new WPV1-positive samples. In Europe, routine wastewater testing from September to December 2024 detected cVDPV2-positive samples in Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany, Poland and Finland.

Tfp8jXIUwygwJAzjBVhQFQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/9-1/15期間,巴基斯坦報告新增2例WPV1型病例;共3國新增11例cVDPV2型病例,分別為衣索比亞7例、查德3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增17件WPV1型陽性樣本;德國新增11件cVDPV2型陽性樣本。
Tfp8jXIUwygwJAzjBVhQFQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 9–15 January, Pakistan reported two new WPV1 cases. Three countries reported 11 new cVDPV2 cases in total: Ethiopia 7, Chad 3 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 17 new WPV1-positive samples, and Germany reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

-b-Fnj4XTjisOFhuNopehA.zh: 衣索比亞疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告840萬例病例,平均每週報告超過30萬例,為病例數最高的一年,流行期分別於每年4-5月及9-12月。
-b-Fnj4XTjisOFhuNopehA.en: Ethiopia epidemic update: So far in 2024, 8.4 million cases have been reported cumulatively, an average of over 300,000 cases per week. This is the year with the highest case count on record. Transmission periods occur in April–May and September–December each year.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

ZopHfn2io6SW6kLwTY29TQ.zh: 香港11/14新增1例本土病例,為22歲無慢性病史女性,疫苗接種史不明,11/8發病,11/12入院隔離治療,潛伏期多出沒於香港城市大學,當局已進行接觸者追蹤,目前無人發病。 衣索比亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告29,391例病例,其中210例死亡,56%病例為5歲以下兒童,且逾6成未接種疫苗,WHO呼籲加強常規疫苗接種。
ZopHfn2io6SW6kLwTY29TQ.en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new locally acquired case on 14 November, a 22-year-old woman with no chronic conditions, whose vaccination history is unknown, with onset on 8 November. She was admitted to hospital for isolation treatment on 12 November. During the incubation period she frequently visited City University of Hong Kong. Authorities have traced contacts, and no contacts have developed symptoms so far.

Ethiopia has cumulatively reported 29,391 cases this year as of mid-October, including 210 deaths. Children under 5 account for 56% of cases, and more than 60% of cases were unvaccinated. WHO calls for strengthened routine vaccination.

bnprSACli8E3REcICwrMaw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/31-11/6期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;剛果民主共和國新增2例cVDPV1病例;共5國新增12例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞7例、葉門2例,衣索比亞/塞內加爾/日各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增53件WPV1陽性樣本;共3國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為阿爾及利亞2件及日/奈及利亞1件。
bnprSACli8E3REcICwrMaw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 31 October and 6 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case; the Democratic Republic of the Congo added 2 cVDPV1 cases; and a total of 5 countries added 12 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 7, Yemen 2, and Ethiopia, Senegal and Niger 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 53 WPV1-positive samples. A total of 3 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples: Algeria 2, and Niger and Nigeria 1 each.

RCWTJ0g-249hYyM4Nw-8Qg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/10-10/16期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;衣索比亞新增2例cVDPV2病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;巴勒斯坦新增5件cVDPV2陽性樣本。 委內瑞拉10/5報告1例VDPV3兒童病例,為該國30年來首例病例。
RCWTJ0g-249hYyM4Nw-8Qg.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 10 and 16 October, Pakistan added 4 WPV1 cases and Ethiopia added 2 cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan added 15 WPV1-positive samples, and Palestine added 5 cVDPV2-positive samples.

Venezuela reported on 5 October 1 VDPV3 child case, the first case in the country in 30 years.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
